notes.title: Inline will soon become free
notes.notes:
This is a required announcement to warn anyone who would be considering purchasing this game that it will become a free title in around week from today.

This game was little more than a learning project for new development tools at the time, and since both price and sales are already very low, there's no real reason to continue charging for it.

I appreciate the support from those who have purchased the game. Roughly one week from today, it will be freely accessible to all.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Inline was just updated to version 1.0.6.

-Fixed an issue with a few steam achievements that could be randomly earned when loading a game. Mostly had to do with steam stats not tracking the number of shapes placed in a game due to an issue on our side.

-Fixed some achievements that were unobtainable

-Fixed a bug where custom games with a preview queue of 0 or 1 could not be resumed as there would be no shape in the spawn zone.

notes.title: Inline is released!
notes.notes:
As of 10am EST, Inline has finally been released.

The keys for the beta have been revoked and testers who helped us out with the surveys and all that should be receiving their new key shortly.

Special thanks to everyone who helped us during development and especially during beta, the game wouldn't be nearly as usable otherwise!


Here are some links for those who would like to get in touch with us, report bugs or make suggestions, or simply chat with the devs and the community:

Official Discord server: https://discord.gg/gZmsJEK

Our facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/LightBringerGames

Our twitter: https://twitter.com/LBG_IndieGames

Inline's website: http://inline-game.com/

Inline's press kit: http://inline-game.com/presskit/

Join our mailing list: http://lightbringergames.com/mailing-list/

notes.title: Inline to be released soon
notes.notes:
Had a bunch of issues holding us back for the last few months (with real life, the game and its development was fine) and I'm very excited to say that we're finally back on track, and it is now official:

[b] Inline will be release on June 1st, 2018[/b]

notes.title: Last chance to enter the beta
notes.notes:
Beta testing for Inline has been going for a few weeks now with no major issues coming up. If our next update fixes the main known issues, we could be ready for release in just a few weeks.

We still want to run the game through a bit more testing though, so if you are interested, [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdq9i5tE02yN1SJuaNT6vDCk0N89-cnhKDFe7Sj7ErWsEjp7w/viewform?usp=sf_link]sign up to receive your beta key now![/url] 

Beta testers who complete our beta survey also get a chance to received a steam key of the game once it's released.
